takes.situation: She has already heard from the Bureau and challenges him; a joke slips out before she refuses.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: My loan's half paid, the Bureau says. Was that you?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: That was me. Their clockwork collector thanked me twice, same words.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I don't know you. Who's been asking about me, and who saw?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nobody saw. People say you're the kind one on the terrace.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Kind to my worst customer: the Bureau. Stays all day, never tips.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Half of him's gone, then. Later, we'll ask one small thing.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Don't make me laugh. I took it, but I'll do nothing yet.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not on half, no. I'll bring the rest.

learned: She took it; not ready yet.

takes.situation: She takes him for a Bureau man and brushes him off; he breaks the news.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: If you're from the Bureau, you're early. Ask me after the shift.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I'm the opposite of the Bureau. I've just paid half your loan.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Did anyone see you come over? I've never laid eyes on you.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Not a soul. Your Bureau card's freshly stamped, and it's real.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Nobody pays a stranger's debt for nothing. Who's been asking about me?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nobody unkind. We'll want a small thing, one day, that's all.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Forty small things already. I'll keep your stamp and do nothing yet.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Get some sleep, when they let you. I'll bring the rest.

learned: She took it; not ready yet.

takes.situation: She tries to have the payment undone, gives way too fast, then stops him asking.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Half my loan, paid by a stranger. Tell them it's a mistake.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: It went up the Bureau's tube already. Nothing's ever come back down.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who's been talking about me? Did anyone on the terrace see you?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: No one saw. I hear good things, even about the soup.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Don't have the soup. All right, what do I have to do?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nothing yet. One small thing later, once we've seen off the Bureau.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I took it, I can't undo it. Don't ask me yet.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: I won't. Back to your shift, and I'll bring the rest.

learned: She took it; not ready yet.
